NAT.PsychicRitualDef_CreateRust.label: rusted infantryman creation
NAT.PsychicRitualDef_CreateRust.description: Create rusted infantryman using bioferrite and dark archotechnology shards. There's always a fail chance, so ritual may require many attempts.
NAT.PsychicRitualDef_CreateRust.outcomeDescription: With the current ritual quality, there is a {0} chance of successful rusted infantryman creation.\n\nIf the ritual fails, some bioferrite and all shards will be lost.
NAT.PsychicRitualDef_CreateRust.successLetterText: {INVOKER_nameDef} has completed {RITUAL_definite} ritual, turning bioferrite into {PAWN_nameDef}({PAWN_kind}).
NAT.PsychicRitualDef_CreateRust.failLetterText: {INVOKER_nameDef} has completed {RITUAL_definite} ritual, but nothing happens.
